description: SPD Flexibility Requirements 2024-2028 is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " SPD Flexibility Requirements 2024-2028 Heat Map " data table provides an indication of potential short and longer term flexibility requirements on the SPM Licence Area's network in upcoming years. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Flexibility. Its keywords are Substation, SPD, Active Power, 132kV, 33kV, 11kV. The portal shows 2025-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
